description: This Java source file defines the TenantDatabaseStateVerifier class, which provides methods to verify the state of tenant databases in terms of Liquibase and Flyway migration versions, using database queries and properties.

classes.name: TenantDatabaseStateVerifier
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for verifying the migration state of tenant databases, including checks for Liquibase and Flyway presence and version status.

methods.name: isFirstLiquibaseMigration
methods.description: Checks whether the database has undergone the first Liquibase migration by verifying the presence of the DATABASECHANGELOG table.

methods.name: isFlywayPresent
methods.description: Determines if Flyway migration tracking table (schema_version) is present in the database.

methods.name: isLiquibaseDisabled
methods.description: Checks if Liquibase is disabled based on properties configuration.

methods.name: isTenantStoreOnLatestUpgradableVersion
methods.description: Verifies if the tenant store database is on the latest upgradable Flyway version.

methods.name: isTenantOnLatestUpgradableVersion
methods.description: Verifies if the tenant database is on the latest upgradable Flyway version.

methods.name: isOnLatestFlywayVersion
methods.description: Internal helper method that checks if a specific database has applied a particular Flyway script and version successfully.
